spec_match.rationale: Measures the explainer's 'maximum number of samples given by chunkSize' claim directly against the real call.

interactive.rationale: Editable chunkSize list and sample-rate select drive a results table; a seam test compares chunked and one-shot renders sample by sample.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The lede states the exact question the page answers and the findings answer it with measured numbers.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers 0, values below, at and above one quantum, non-multiples, and sizes beyond the remaining frames.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus.com/feature/5109900936085504 entry or the feature index, plus the explainer.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (8 assertions) passes 8/8 on Chrome 158; the shared support panel renders it on this page.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Driven on Chrome for Testing 158.0.8127.36 (headless, Linux, no flags) via Playwright, 2026-11-27 at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; every control exercised, console and network clean. Not verified with chrome-devtools-mcp (not available in the cloud routine).

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.support() reports the close() probe once; assert() covers the primary contract.

design_system.rationale: Only CSS variables from public/styles.css; every button that sets a background also sets color.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, 44px targets, polite live regions, captioned tables in named scroll regions.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360px; controls reflow with auto-fit grids; checked in screenshots at both sizes.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap data tables in a scrollable container with tabindex="0", role="region" and an accessible name from the caption; use th scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every results table sits in a .table-wrap with tabindex=0, role=region and aria-labelledby pointing at its caption; verified no page-level horizontal overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Yield to the main thread inside long loops (scheduler.yield with a setTimeout fallback) to protect INP.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception: every render loop awaits one startRendering() promise per chunk, which already returns to the event loop between chunks; the only synchronous loop (seam comparison) is capped at 480,000 floats and measured at a few ms.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native labelled controls, visible focus, and polite live regions for asynchronous results.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Native button/select/input with label for, 44px minimum targets, results in output/role=status elements with aria-live=polite.

summary: Yes, it returns more: Chrome 158 rounds chunkSize up to a multiple of 128 (300 -> 384, 1 -> 128, 1000 -> 1024) and throws NotSupportedError for 0. Seams are exact: chunked output matched the one-shot render with maximum difference 0.
